style_suggestion.reasoning: Classic comes only from 'modern elegance' in the old Description. The site and a quoted planner describe it as sleek, simple and modern, with dark-walled and gallery-style rooms; nothing historic or traditional. The corrected Description drops 'elegance', so the rules give Modern only. If the team keeps 'elegant' as a Classic cue, this venue shows why the rule should ignore 'elegant' when it is paired with modern/contemporary.
